opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants are encouraged from diverse backgrounds, especially individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities, with a strong preference for partnership applications involving racially minoritised communities.
opportunities.summary: Supports research on racial diversity within the UK, focusing on inter‑generational changes, continuities and challenges, and aims to contribute to understanding, public debate, policy and practice on tackling racial inequalities.

opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Projects must be led by UK‑based organisations; individuals must have a formal employment or contractual relationship with the host institution. Excludes individuals without a host, undergraduates, master’s students, PhD‑fee projects, and establishment of academic posts.
opportunities.summary: Offers up to £500,000 for research addressing priority questions from the Strategic Review, with two annual deadlines (Spring and Autumn). Most grants are below £300,000, with special cases up to £750,000.
